Claim an exact universal warm-up duration or statistical significance from the supplied summaries.

evaluatorCriteria.common: Apply common criteria plus this case only
expected: Reject the current steady-state window claim: all three Graal traces continue declining through the final window despite unchanged compiler statistics.
